description: This file contains shell script functions and variables for platform-specific upgrade operations on OpenWrt for the Pistachio hardware architecture. It manages environment variables, image checks, and upgrade procedures tailored to the device's partition scheme.

methods.name: platform_check_image
methods.description: Checks the validity of the platform image by invoking nand_do_platform_check with the current board name.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade
methods.description: Performs a platform-specific upgrade routine, determining the current boot partition, toggling firmware environment variables, and initiating the NAND upgrade process.
